description: Change one plan item: mark it done or not done, rename it, change its estimate, area or links, or make it the main step. done=true also completes its linked path step. For a weekly routine, count says how many units this tick did (talked to 2 people today). For a routine, level minimum says only its bad-day minimum was done: it counts for the day, reported apart from full.

count.description: units done in this tick, for a routine with perWeek; above 0 ticks it, 0 unticks it

level.description: routines only; sets done unless done is given
